title: Etale-local parameter-root quotients of invertible-order torsors
statement:
Let $Y$ be an integral regular Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-regular-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], $T\subset Y$ a strict normal crossings boundary [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], and $V=Y\setminus|T|$. Let $G$ be a finite group, put $n=|G|$, assume $n$ invertible on $Y$, and let $V'\to V$ be a connected finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose its normalization $b:Z\to Y$ in $k(V')/k(Y)$ is finite [def-fin-normalization-extension, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Fix geometric points $\bar z$ above $\bar y$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Then there exist pointed affine etale neighbourhoods $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ and $W\to Z$, a map $W\to U$ over $b$, elements $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in A$ for some $r\ge0$, an element $\zeta\in A^\times$, and a subgroup $H\subseteq(\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z)^r$, with the following properties. The ring $A$ is regular Noetherian and $W$ is Noetherian. The $t_i$ are local equations of precisely the components of $T_U$ through the selected point, belong to its maximal ideal, and form part of a regular system of parameters there [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]; $V\times_Y U=D(t_1\cdots t_r)$. One has $\zeta^n=1$ and $1-\zeta^a\in A^\times$ for $1\le a<n$. For
$$B=A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]/(x_1^n-t_1,\ldots,x_r^n-t_r),$$
let $H$ act by fixing $A$ and sending $x_i$ to $\zeta^{h_i}x_i$ for $h=(h_i)\in H$. There is an isomorphism $W\cong\operatorname{Spec}(B^H)$ over $U$, where $B^H=\{b\in B:h(b)=b\text{ for every }h\in H\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Moreover $U$ may be required to refine any prescribed pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar y$ on which the components through $\bar y$ have parameter equations; the $t_i$ can be taken to be the pullbacks of those equations, after shrinking away the other components. The empty boundary gives $r=0$, $B=A$ and $H=0$. No log structure on $Z$ or monoid chart for $b$ is asserted.
